worlds.name: Grask
worlds.description: A shard opened two generations ago and still being emptied. Ravvan the Wide Mouth keeps it rich; Mhorrek keeps the account.

zones.name: Stiltmarsh
zones.description: The wet ground east of the cut, built over rather than drained.

zones.name: The Cutting
zones.description: The first claim, worked out and worked again. Half-built, over-supplied, loud.

zones.name: The Landing
zones.description: Where everything arriving in Grask arrives, and where most of it is sold twice.

zones.name: The Owing
zones.description: Ravvan's deepest cut, and Mhorrek's ledger. Work stopped here abruptly.

rooms.title: The Black Reach
rooms.description:
Open water, still and lightless, with the boardwalk running out across it on piles that get further apart as they go.

Nothing grows here. The reeds stop at a line as clean as a wall.

rooms.title: The Boardwalk Head
rooms.description:
The cut wall ends and the ground gives out into standing water and sedge. A boardwalk on driven piles goes out into it, three planks wide, with no rail.

The piles are new. The ones beside them, at the same spacing, are not.

rooms.title: The Drowned Stand
rooms.description:
Alders standing dead in three feet of water, bark gone, every trunk pale and smooth. Something has scored all of them at the same height.

The height is above yours.

rooms.title: The Eel Traps
rooms.description:
A line of wicker traps on a rope, hauled and reset twice a day. The eels here are enormous and everyone in Grask eats them without comment.

The last three traps on the line have not been reset in a while.

rooms.title: The Far Staging
rooms.description:
The last platform, where the marsh stops mattering and the edge of Grask begins. Crates are stacked here for a crossing that has not run in some time.

The water simply stops, and the stopping has an edge to it.

Out past the staging the shapes are nearer than an Ossaran would say they should be, and one of them has something on it that is not land. Nobody in the Landing looks for long, and everybody has a view about it.

rooms.title: The First Platform
rooms.description:
A square of decking on piles, wide enough for a hut and a stack of crates, with the hut leaning and the crates newer than it.

Somebody lives here. Somebody has lived here a long time.

rooms.title: The Hog Wallow
rooms.description:
A shelf of firm mud among the reeds, churned to soup and stinking, where the marsh boars come out of the water to lie in the sun.

They are the size of the punts and they are not afraid of them.

rooms.title: The Lamp Store
rooms.description:
A shed of oil, wick and hooded lamps, kept as far from the workings as the boardwalk allows, which is not far.

Every lamp is signed out against a name.

rooms.title: The Long Walk
rooms.description:
Four hundred feet of boardwalk with black water on both sides and nowhere to step off. The planks move under you in sequence as you go.

Things come up alongside and keep pace and go back down.

rooms.title: The Old Piles
rooms.description:
Two hundred piles in rows, driven a lifetime ago, holding nothing up. The boardwalk they carried is not here and there is no record of it being taken away.

They are the first company's spacing.

rooms.title: The Piling Yard
rooms.description:
A working platform where the piles are cut and driven, with a ram frame standing over it and a crew of six who never stop.

The far end of the yard is stacked with piles pulled back out of the marsh. They are chewed.

rooms.title: The Reed Cut
rooms.description:
A channel hacked through reeds twice head height, wide enough for one punt, with the reeds closing over the top.

You can hear everything and see nothing at all.

rooms.title: The Sunk Claim
rooms.description:
A claim that flooded and was abandoned, with the winding gear still standing out of the water at an angle and a boardwalk running to it out of habit.

The company still owns this. The company owns a lot of water.

rooms.title: The Tallyman's Post
rooms.description:
A hut on piles beside the long walk, where a company man counts everyone in and everyone out and does not ask about the difference.

The out column is shorter. It has been shorter for years.

rooms.title: The Underdeck
rooms.description:
Below the piling yard, on a service walk a foot above the water, where the piles come down and the light does not.

This is where the things that live under the boardwalks live.

rooms.title: The Claim Line
rooms.description:
A line of whitewashed stakes running up the cut wall, marking where one company's ground stops. Six of the stakes are new and are not in line with the others.

This is where the arguments happen and it is obvious why.

rooms.title: The Crossing Plank
rooms.description:
Two planks and a handrail over the sump at the bottom of the cut, sagging in the middle, replaced often enough that nobody trusts it and everybody uses it.

The sump below has no bottom anyone has found with a rope.

rooms.title: The Drowned Bench
rooms.description:
A level the adit does not quite drain, standing in a foot of still brown water with the tops of abandoned gear showing above it.

Something is using it. The water is disturbed in a line, and the line moves.

rooms.title: The Far Face
rooms.description:
The working face at the far end, where the cut is still being pushed forward a foot a week into rock that has stopped being generous.

The ore ran out here two years ago. They are still cutting.

rooms.title: The First Ramp
rooms.description:
A switchback of packed spoil going down into the cut, wide enough for a cart if the cart is careful and nobody is coming up.

The walls on either side are stepped where the claim was worked out in courses.

rooms.title: The Second Bench
rooms.description:
A worked-out level, flat and littered, with the rock face rising on one side and a drop fenced with rope on the other.

Nobody works this bench any more. Plenty of people are on it.

rooms.title: The Spoil Run
rooms.description:
The tip: everything the cut did not want, in a slope of grey rubble a hundred feet long, still steaming faintly where it was turned this morning.

People work it who are not supposed to.

rooms.title: The Sump Shelf
rooms.description:
A ledge above the sump where the pumps are, three of them, two working. The noise here makes conversation a matter of pointing.

Whoever built the mountings knew what they were doing and did not work for the company.

rooms.title: The Third Bench
rooms.description:
Live workings. Picks going, a windlass turning, and four crews who all believe the other three are on their ground.

The boundary pegs have been moved. All of them, by everybody.

rooms.title: The Tool Shed
rooms.description:
A lean-to cut into the ramp wall, holding picks, wedges and a man whose whole job is signing them out.

Everything in here is company property, stamped twice.

rooms.title: The Underhang
rooms.description:
Where the face has been undercut and left, a lip of rock overhanging thirty feet of nothing much, propped with timbers that are doing visible work.

Beyond and below, a second slot goes down further than this one. Nobody calls it the second cut.

rooms.title: The Water Adit
rooms.description:
A tunnel driven in to drain the cut, running ankle-deep and echoing. It works, mostly, which is why the cut is not a lake.

It is also the only way between two benches without going up.

rooms.title: The Boom Road
rooms.description:
The road out to the workings, wide, rutted, and carrying carts in both directions all day. It was laid in a hurry and has been repaired in a bigger hurry ever since.

Half the buildings along it are unfinished and occupied.

rooms.title: The Company Yard
rooms.description:
Stacked timber, coiled rope, and a locked shed with a man sitting on it. The company owns everything in Grask that is not nailed down and quite a lot that is.

A tally of crews is chalked on the shed door. The last line has been rubbed out and not rewritten.

rooms.title: The Cut Head
rooms.description:
Where the road stops being a road and becomes the top of the first claim: a raw slot in the ground with a switchback ramp going down into it.

The noise comes up out of it all day and most of the night.

rooms.title: The Gate Quay
rooms.description:
The ring stands at the head of a stone quay, and unlike Ossara's it is busy: a crew of four works the crossing all day, waving loads through in both directions.

Yrriska's shrine here is enormous and disgraceful, three feet deep in coins and dice and written oaths, and the crew touch it every single time.

The way through is up, which the crew stopped finding remarkable about a generation ago. They call it stepping off, and they shout it at each other all day.

rooms.title: The Hiring Step
rooms.description:
A flight of six broad steps outside the company office, where crews are taken on. Men and women sit on them all morning waiting to be pointed at.

The board lists three cuts by name and a fourth by depth only.

rooms.title: The Ironmonger
rooms.description:
Racks of tools, racks of parts of tools, and a forge at the back going all day. Hask buys anything iron by weight and sells it back to you shaped.

The scrap pile has three broken picks in it with the same company mark.

rooms.title: The Market Run
rooms.description:
A street of stalls that has grown until it is three streets, and the middle one has no name because it was not there last year.

Nothing sold here was made here. Everything sold here has been sold at least once already.

rooms.title: The Outfitter's
rooms.description:
Two floors of stock in a building meant for one, with the upper floor visibly bowing and a sign on the stair that says ONE AT A TIME and is ignored.

Everything you could want is here. So is everything you could not.

rooms.title: The Provision Stall
rooms.description:
Sacks, barrels and a slate listing what a three-day crew needs, in a hand that has corrected the water figure upwards twice.

Everything here is priced for people who will pay it because they have to.

rooms.title: The Rope Walk
rooms.description:
A shed four hundred feet long and eight wide, where three people walk backwards all day laying rope. It is the most orderly thing in Grask.

The rope made here is the reason anybody comes back up.

rooms.title: The Staging
rooms.description:
A platform of scaffold and plank thrown out over the edge, loaded with crates waiting for the next crossing. It sways, and everyone has agreed not to discuss it.

From out here you can see past the Landing entirely.

Out past the staging the shapes are nearer than an Ossaran would say they should be, and one of them has something on it that is not land. Nobody in the Landing looks for long, and everybody has a view about it.

rooms.title: The Tally House
rooms.description:
A long shed open on the quay side, with three clerks at three desks and a queue that never gets shorter. Everything crossing the gate is weighed, named and written down.

The ledgers go back to the opening. The early volumes are on a shelf nobody dusts.

rooms.title: The Abandoned Face
rooms.description:
A working face, mid-cut, with the marks of the last blow still fresh on it and the spoil not carried away.

It is not old. Everything about it says the crew stepped away an hour ago.

rooms.title: The Barrow Run
rooms.description:
A ramp of packed spoil worn into a groove, running from the drop above down to the drift. Wide enough for one barrow, and polished at barrow height along both walls.

A barrow stands at the bottom of the run, still loaded, handles up on a prop. The prop is a shovel.

Whoever set it down meant to be back inside the hour.

rooms.title: The Cold Store
rooms.description:
A chamber off the stair, cut square, holding nothing at all. The air in it is noticeably colder than the stair and does not move.

It was cut deliberately. It has never been used for anything.

rooms.title: The Deep Sump
rooms.description:
Water at the bottom of a shaft the stair passes, black and absolutely still, with a rope going into it that has been there long enough to have grown a skin.

The rope is taut.

rooms.title: The First Turn
rooms.description:
The stair turns back on itself for the first time. From here the light from the top is a shape rather than a light.

Somebody has cut a tally into the wall at the turn. It stops at forty-one.

rooms.title: The First Workings
rooms.description:
The bottom of the Owing, and the oldest cut in Grask: the hole the first company drove two generations ago before there was a Landing to come back to.

The gate-stone is in the wall here, raw and unshaped, and the first mark is cut into it. Azhen cut every gate in the Reaches. This is the piece they cut them from.

The way through is up, out of the bottom of the deepest cut in Grask. The company that drove this hole went up to leave it and went up to come back, and wrote both down the same way.

exits.refusalMessage: The raw stone takes your hand and gives nothing back. Whatever reads a mark here has not read yours.

rooms.title: The Lamp Line
rooms.description:
Hooks driven into the wall every twenty feet, each with a lamp, each lamp lit. Somebody comes down here twice a day and fills all of them.

The line goes further down than the workings do.

rooms.title: The Ledger Room
rooms.description:
A chamber cut square and dry, with a shelf along one wall and books on the shelf. This far down, dry, with books, and no reason for any of it.

The entries are wages. They are still being made.

rooms.title: The Head of the Owing
rooms.description:
A slot going down out of the underhang, narrower than the cut above and far deeper, with a stair of cut steps hugging one wall.

There is no windlass and no rope. Everything that comes out of here is carried.

rooms.title: The Quiet Drift
rooms.description:
A drift running off the ledger room, level and dry, going nowhere in particular for about two hundred feet before it simply stops.

There is no face at the end. The rock is finished, like a wall.

rooms.title: The Second Turn
rooms.description:
The second switchback, and the last one with a handrail. Below this the steps are cut into the wall and nothing else.

The tally continues here in a different hand.

rooms.title: The Standing Account
rooms.description:
A chamber past the first workings that nobody cut. The walls are the same dark stone as a gate, all the way round, with no seam and no face.

The first crew is here. They are in their kit, and they are working, and they have been paid every week since.

rooms.title: The Tool Drop
rooms.description:
A widening where a crew's gear is stacked against the wall: picks, wedges, three lamps, and a coat with the sleeves still turned out.

All of it is laid out for the start of a shift.

itemTemplates.name: a roll of clean bandage
itemTemplates.description: Boiled linen, rolled tight, tied with a scrap of the same. Sold by the roll because nobody needs half of one.

itemTemplates.name: a loaf of dark bread
itemTemplates.description: Heavy, close-grained, and baked at Khaldra's Hearth like everything else in this town. Keeps four days and admits it.

itemTemplates.name: an unproven stormrod
itemTemplates.description: Bronze wound with wire that stands the hair up on your arm when the weather turns. Newly made and honest about it. Vesh will not pretend this is finished.

itemTemplates.name: a tempered stormrod
itemTemplates.description: Bronze wound with wire that stands the hair up on your arm when the weather turns. Folded again with something out of Grask in it, and heavier for the knowing.

itemTemplates.name: an unproven hearthcenser
itemTemplates.description: A censer on a chain, weighted for swinging and never once used for incense. Newly made and honest about it. Vesh will not pretend this is finished.

itemTemplates.name: a tempered hearthcenser
itemTemplates.description: A censer on a chain, weighted for swinging and never once used for incense. Folded again with something out of Grask in it, and heavier for the knowing.

itemTemplates.name: a pair of unproven quiet wraps
itemTemplates.description: They make no sound until they land. Somebody took a great deal of trouble over that. Newly made and honest about it. Vesh will not pretend this is finished.

itemTemplates.name: a pair of tempered quiet wraps
itemTemplates.description: They make no sound until they land. Somebody took a great deal of trouble over that. Folded again with something out of Grask in it, and heavier for the knowing.

itemTemplates.name: an unproven oathmaul
itemTemplates.description: Head like a milestone, haft the length of a person. It was made to stop something. Newly made and honest about it. Vesh will not pretend this is finished.

itemTemplates.name: a tempered oathmaul
itemTemplates.description: Head like a milestone, haft the length of a person. It was made to stop something. Folded again with something out of Grask in it, and heavier for the knowing.

itemTemplates.name: a claimjumper's cleaver
itemTemplates.description: Broad, short, and made for arguments about boundaries. Not one of them has a maker mark.

itemTemplates.name: a claim-marked shield
itemTemplates.description: Iron-rimmed, with a company mark burned into it and two other marks burned out underneath.

itemTemplates.name: a crew tag
itemTemplates.description: A stamped tin oval on a wire loop, worn under the shirt. The company issues one to everyone who goes down the cut.

itemTemplates.name: a dredging hook
itemTemplates.description: A boat hook shortened for close work, with the point re-drawn so many times the head is half its first size.

itemTemplates.name: the first mark
itemTemplates.description: A palm-sized wedge of gate-stone with a company mark cut into it - the oldest mark in Grask, made by people who did not know what they were signing.

itemTemplates.name: a leaf from the deep ledger
itemTemplates.description: One page, water-stained, in a hand that runs out of patience halfway down and starts abbreviating.

itemTemplates.name: a long pick
itemTemplates.description: Reach and leverage, which is what you want against something that has committed to a charge.

itemTemplates.name: a pair of marsh boots
itemTemplates.description: Thigh high, greased, and sold with the honest warning that they will fill and that you should still wear them.

itemTemplates.name: a debt token
itemTemplates.description: A brass disc stamped with a sum and a name. Nobody in Grask thinks it is odd to wear one.

itemTemplates.name: a hooded pit lamp
itemTemplates.description: Tin, hooded on three sides so the flame does not blind the man behind you. The Owing runs on these and the Owing charges for them.

itemTemplates.name: a plated dredger coat
itemTemplates.description: Canvas with iron plates riveted between the layers, cut long. Heavy out of the water and heavier in it.

itemTemplates.name: a pair of rigger's gloves
itemTemplates.description: Palms doubled and doubled again, because rope on a wet claim takes fingers off people who economise.

itemTemplates.name: a pair of studded breeches
itemTemplates.description: Hide with a stud pattern that was fashionable in the Landing for one season and is now just what everyone owns.

itemTemplates.name: a tallow-proofed cap
itemTemplates.description: Boiled felt soaked in tallow until it turns rain. It smells, and everyone here smells of it.

itemTemplates.name: a coil of hemp rope
itemTemplates.description: Twenty feet, laid three-strand, with the ends whipped properly. Whoever made this was not in a hurry.

itemTemplates.name: a pitch torch
itemTemplates.description: A hand's length of ash wrapped in pitch-soaked rag. Takes a hand to carry and smells like it the whole time.

itemTemplates.name: a stitched waterskin
itemTemplates.description: Goat hide, double-stitched, with a wooden stopper on a cord so you cannot lose it. You will lose it.

mobTemplates.name: a boar
mobTemplates.description: Waist high at the shoulder and built entirely for going forward. It commits early and it takes a long moment to turn.

mobTemplates.name: a brigand
mobTemplates.description: One of a crew holding ground nobody gave them. Well equipped, badly led, and very committed to the fiction.

mobTemplates.name: a bruiser
mobTemplates.description: Paid to be somewhere and be large about it. Not enthusiastic, extremely thorough.

mobTemplates.name: a cutpurse
mobTemplates.description: Light, fast, and a week ahead of a question they did not want to answer.

mobTemplates.name: Vesh, who follows the gates
mobTemplates.description: A smith with a travelling anvil and no forge, who has been at every crossing anyone can remember and looks no older in any of the stories. She works for materials and will not take coin.

emotes.text: turns a piece over and puts it back in the bag unfinished
says, 'I do not sell. Bring me something and I will make it better.'
sets an anvil down that nobody saw her carrying

greeting: 'You have seen me before. You will again. I do not explain that and neither should you.'
'I do not sell. Bring me something that has been through something and I will make it better. Ask about the <embers> if you want to know what I work with.'

topics.text: 'They do not go out and they do not warm anything. I keep a jar. Where the first one came from is a thing I know and a thing you do not need to.'
'Every crossing anyone can remember, and I am at every one of them. I do not go through. I am at. Those are different, and the difference is most of what I know.'

mobTemplates.name: Reddick Vance, company clerk
mobTemplates.description: He hires crews for the deep cut, is scrupulously honest about the pay, and changes the subject with real skill when asked what is down there.

emotes.text: checks a name against a list and makes a small mark beside it
says, 'The pay is the pay. I have never short-changed anyone. Ask.'

greeting: 'The pay is the pay. I have never short-changed anyone. Ask about the <pay> if you doubt it.'
'Names on the left, marks on the right. Everything I hire is on this list, and most of what I hire comes back.'

topics.text: 'Company rate, paid weekly, paid in full. I swore to Kheddran on it when I took the post and I have not needed to think about the oath since, which is what an oath is for.'

'The given word. A clerk's god, if a clerk has one. You write a name against a promise and the promise is kept or you are not a clerk any more. That is the whole religion, and it fits on a ledger line.'

'The first company. Two generations back, before the Landing had a name. They opened the gate and went down, and the book says they were paid. It does not say by whom. I have hired for eleven years and never once seen one of their tags come up on its own.'

mobTemplates.name: a crow
mobTemplates.description: It has worked out which crates hold food and which hands hold food, and it prefers the hands.

mobTemplates.name: Ista Roan, deep foreman
mobTemplates.description: She has been down the Owing more times than anyone alive and has stopped pretending it is an ordinary hole.

emotes.text: checks a lamp, then checks it again
says, 'It does not pay down there. Work it out, and then come and ask me.'

greeting: 'It does not pay down there. Work it out, and then come and ask me about the <sump>.'

topics.text: 'Black water at the bottom of a shaft, and a rope going into it that has been there long enough to grow a skin. The rope is taut. Do not touch the rope. I am not superstitious, and I am telling you not to touch the rope.'

'Three of them, two working, and the mountings they sit on were cut by somebody who knew what they were doing and did not work for the company. Square, to a tolerance, older than the cut. We built on top of them. We did not build them.'

'You have seen it, then. Every gate in the Reaches, and the mountings under my pumps, and the stone the first company cut its mark into. They were here before any of us and they left the instruments running. Ask them what the terms were. We plainly did not.'

mobTemplates.name: a hound
mobTemplates.description: Half the Landing feeds them and none of them belong to anybody. They work in fours.

mobTemplates.name: Hask, ironmonger
mobTemplates.description: Buys broken metal by weight and sells it back shaped, at a margin he will describe as fair if you ask and generous if you do not.

emotes.text: weighs something, frowns, and weighs it again on the other scale

greeting: 'Broken metal by weight, shaped metal by the piece. The difference is my <margin>.'

topics.text: 'Fair, if you ask. Generous, if you do not. Everything in Grask is marked up twice on its way to you, and I am only one of the two.'

mobTemplates.name: a kept miner
mobTemplates.description: A crew member of the first company, still in their kit, still on shift. Mhorrek does not forgive and does not forget to collect.

mobTemplates.name: Bessa Krail, outfitter
mobTemplates.description: She sells more than you need and tells you so while she is selling it.

emotes.text: says, 'You will want the boots. You will not want the price of the boots.'

greeting: 'You will want the boots. You will not want the price of the boots. Ask about the <lamp> before you go down.'

topics.text: 'Hooded pit lamp. Hangs off you, not off your hand, so you keep the hand for a shield. Eight times the price of a torch, and the Owing is dark all the way down, so you decide what a hand is worth.'

mobTemplates.name: Tam Oduls, provisioner
mobTemplates.description: Sells to crews going down the cut and has strong opinions about how much water people think they need.

emotes.text: says, 'Three days of water. Not two. I have seen two.'

greeting: 'Three days of water. Not two. I have seen two. Ask about <water> and I will say it again.'

topics.text: 'The cut is dry and the marsh is not drinkable and the Owing is neither. Three days, in skins, on your back. The people who took two are the reason I say three.'

mobTemplates.name: Ollam Vech, quaymaster
mobTemplates.description: He logs everything that crosses the gate and has never once been caught out on a number. He is also visibly a week from collapsing.

emotes.text: runs a finger down a column and does not like the total
says, 'Everything that comes through here is written down. Everything.'

greeting: 'If you carried it through the gate, it is in the book. If it is not in the book, you did not.'
He blinks at you, slowly. 'Name and load. Or step aside. Preferably both.'
'Everything that crosses is in the <book>. Ask about it and I will show you the column it is in.'

topics.text: 'Every load, every name, both directions, since the crossing opened. I have never once been caught out on a number. I am also, as you can see, a week from falling over. Those are the same fact.'

'It works. It has always worked. A crew of four steps loads off all day and nobody has ever asked it to do anything else. The Ossaran one stopped, I hear. Ask me what that costs and I will tell you I do not know.'

'Mine, as it happens. A notary who logs a gate is exactly what his clergy look like. The book is the oath: if it is not in the book, it did not cross. If that sounds like theology, it is because it is.'

'The first company is in the book. Eleven names, going down. There is no line for them coming back up, and the book has never been wrong, so draw your own conclusion. I drew mine years ago and I have not slept properly since.'

mobTemplates.name: a rat
mobTemplates.description: Bigger than the Ossaran kind and entirely unbothered by lamplight.

mobTemplates.name: the Creditor
mobTemplates.description: It wears the first foreman's coat and carries the first foreman's book, and the book is full.

mobTemplates.name: a lurcher
mobTemplates.description: Long, low and the colour of whatever it is lying in. It does not chase. It waits where the way narrows and it gets a grip on you.

abilities.name: Kick
abilities.description: A boot to the knee. Nothing elegant, and it does not care what you are holding.

abilities.name: Bash
abilities.description: Put your shoulder behind it. Slower, and it lands heavier.

abilities.name: Battle Fury
abilities.description: Anger sharpens the next stretch of a fight.

abilities.name: Sunder
abilities.description: Batter the guard apart. What comes next lands on what is left of it.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description: Say something unforgivable about its mother, at volume.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description: The flat of the shield, hard, into whatever is nearest to a jaw.

abilities.name: Rally
abilities.description: Find your feet again in the middle of it.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.description: Set yourself. Nothing moves you for a while.

abilities.name: Crushing Blow
abilities.description: One heavy swing, wound up and committed to.

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.description: Refuse to fall. The refusal is most of it.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.description: Shield into the ground, once. Everything in the room decides you are the problem.

abilities.name: Bulwark
abilities.description: Everything behind you is behind you.

abilities.name: Ground and Centre
abilities.description: More of you to get through, and less give in any of it.

abilities.name: Reprisal
abilities.description: Answer it, and make sure it noticed who did.

abilities.name: Unbreakable
abilities.description: Decide not to. The fight can disagree for a while.

abilities.name: Sundering Blow
abilities.description: Take the guard apart so that everyone else's work lands on what is left.

abilities.name: Mass Provocation
abilities.description: Say the unforgivable thing to the whole room, and mean every word of it.

abilities.name: The Last Wall
abilities.description: There is a place past which things do not go. You are standing on it.

abilities.name: Bolt
abilities.description: A thrown splinter of raw force.

abilities.name: Arcane Shield
abilities.description: A shell of ordered air, briefly.

abilities.name: Weaken
abilities.description: Unpick the strength out of something.

abilities.name: Amplify
abilities.description: Wind the next few strikes tighter.

abilities.name: Scorch
abilities.description: Heat with intent behind it, and nowhere for the heat to go.

abilities.name: Enfeeble
abilities.description: Take the fight out of it at the root.

abilities.name: Disjunction
abilities.description: Pull something apart along the seams it did not know it had.

abilities.name: Firestorm
abilities.description: Fill the room with fire and let it decide what burns.

abilities.name: Transmutation
abilities.description: Spend the body to feed the mind. It takes a moment, and it is not a trick you have twice.

abilities.name: Cataclysm
abilities.description: The long words. Slow to say, and worth saying.

abilities.name: Conflagration
abilities.description: Set the air going and let it keep going.

abilities.name: Shatter
abilities.description: Find the fault, and put everything into it.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.description: It picks its own way across the room and is not slow about it.

abilities.name: Unmaking
abilities.description: Take away some of what it is, and it hits like something less.

abilities.name: Pyre
abilities.description: Everything in the room, twice - once now and once for a while afterwards.

abilities.name: Arcane Surge
abilities.description: The window you fire the long words through.

abilities.name: Gravity Well
abilities.description: Nothing in the room is going anywhere, and standing there is costing it.

abilities.name: The Unwriting
abilities.description: Say what a thing is not, at sufficient volume.

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.description: In and out before it turns.

abilities.name: Evasion
abilities.description: Not being where the blow lands.

abilities.name: Fortify
abilities.description: Settle your grip and pick the angle.

abilities.name: Low Kick
abilities.description: Take the leg out from under it. Whatever it was going to do next, it is not going anywhere.

abilities.name: Body Blow
abilities.description: Ribs, and what is behind them. It will be feeling this for a while.

abilities.name: Provoke
abilities.description: A hit where it will be noticed, and a look daring it to do something about it.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.description: The fight has been going a while. You have more left in you than it has.

abilities.name: Heart Strike
abilities.description: One place, once, properly.

abilities.name: Pressure Point
abilities.description: Find the place that runs the rest of it, and close it.

abilities.name: Rupture
abilities.description: Something inside it is now outside the arrangement.

abilities.name: Opening
abilities.description: Cheap, fast, and it makes the next one worse for them.

abilities.name: Flurry
abilities.description: More than it can count, in less time than it has.

abilities.name: Hemorrhage
abilities.description: Cheap to start and expensive to be on the wrong end of.

abilities.name: Execution
abilities.description: The whole fight, arriving at once and slightly early.

abilities.name: Temple Strike
abilities.description: The heel of the hand, where the skull is thinnest. It forgets what it was doing.

abilities.name: A Hundred Hands
abilities.description: None of them would have done it. All of them will.

abilities.name: Collapse
abilities.description: Take the fight out of it and the rest follows on its own.

abilities.name: Mend
abilities.description: Close what is open, on yourself or on someone beside you.

abilities.name: Guidance
abilities.description: Steady a hand that is about to need steadying.

abilities.name: Wither
abilities.description: Set something going that will not stop on its own.

abilities.name: Restore
abilities.description: Put back what the fight has taken so far.

abilities.name: Blessing
abilities.description: Lend the next while a better edge than it earned.

abilities.name: Renewal
abilities.description: Begin again, without stopping.

abilities.name: Sap
abilities.description: Take the strength and do not give it back.

abilities.name: Benediction
abilities.description: Say it over everyone at once, and mean it.

abilities.name: Intercession
abilities.description: Stand between someone and what was coming for them.

abilities.name: Communion
abilities.description: Say it once, for everyone standing with you.

abilities.name: Reproach
abilities.description: A judgement that settles in and stays. It is not shouted; it is simply true.

abilities.name: Fortitude
abilities.description: More of everyone to get through. Set it before you go in.

abilities.name: Staunch
abilities.description: Pressure and a steady hand. No light, no words - just the bleeding stopped.

abilities.name: Aegis
abilities.description: Something between the group and the weather.

abilities.name: Mending Tide
abilities.description: The one that comes in over everyone at once, when Communion was not enough.

abilities.name: The Account
abilities.description: Everything owed, called in at once. You have been keeping it whether you meant to or not.

abilities.name: Sanctuary
abilities.description: Draw the line around all of them at once, and make it hold.

abilities.name: Absolution
abilities.description: Everything, off one person, now.

abilities.name: Consecration
abilities.description: Support that is not mending: the whole group hits like it means it.

abilities.name: The Long Vigil
abilities.description: Close what is open, raise what is left, and stand over all of it.

quests.name: Signed On
quests.summary: Recover eight crew tags from the kept miners.
quests.description: The company would like its tags back. Vance is careful to say that this is about the tags, and careful not to say anything about who is wearing them.

dialogue.giverOffer: Vance does not look up from the list. 'Every tag is issued against a name. I have names with no <tags> and I cannot close the book. Bring me eight and I will pay you properly and we will both stop thinking about it.'
dialogue.turninReady: He lays them out in a row and reads each one before he writes it off. 'These are first-company names,' he says. 'Every one. I have been hiring for eleven years and I have never once seen a first-company tag come back up.'
dialogue.giverComplete: 'Eight, and do not clean them. I need to read them.'
dialogue.giverInProgress: 'Eight. They are down the Owing, mostly. I am not going to pretend otherwise and I would rather you heard it from me.'

quests.name: The Deep Ledger
quests.summary: Bring five leaves of the deep ledger to Ista Roan.
quests.description: There is a dry room full of books at the bottom of a wet hole, and the wages in it are still being entered. Roan wants pages, and she wants them read out loud to her.

dialogue.giverOffer: Roan checks her lamp. 'There is a room down there with books in it, dry as a bone, four hundred feet under a marsh. Bring me <five pages>. I want to know what is being written and I have stopped being able to go and look.'
dialogue.turninReady: She spreads them out and goes down the columns with a fingernail. 'Wages,' she says. 'Paid weekly. Same names as Vance's tags, and the last entry is this week.' She sits down on a crate. 'Somebody is still settling up. Nobody has been down there to do it.'
dialogue.giverComplete: 'Five. And mind the rope in the sump. Do not touch the rope in the sump.'
dialogue.giverInProgress: 'Five leaves. Do not read them on the stair. Read them up here where I can see your face.'

quests.name: What Was Paid
quests.summary: Take the first mark from the Creditor.
quests.description: Past the first workings there is a room nobody cut, and the first crew is in it, still on shift. The mark they cut into the gate-stone is the oldest thing in Grask, and Roan has decided it is time somebody read the terms.

dialogue.giverOffer: 'The richest hole in the Reaches and it does not pay a copper,' Roan says. 'You noticed. Everyone notices and nobody says it out loud. That is because <the gold> from the Owing is going somewhere, and it has been going there since before the Landing had a name.'
dialogue.turninReady: Roan turns the wedge over twice and puts it down as though it were hot. 'They opened the gate on credit,' she says. 'Two generations of us eating well on it. Mhorrek is not a punishment, he is an invoice.' She presses the mark into your hand. 'Azhen built the gates. Go and ask them what the terms were, because we plainly did not.'
dialogue.giverComplete: 'He is still down there. He is not going anywhere. That is rather the point of him.'
dialogue.giverInProgress: 'Past the first workings. There is a chamber that nobody cut - you will know it, the walls are gate-stone all the way round. He is in there with the book. Bring me the mark.'

quests.name: The Stormrod, tempered
quests.description: Vesh works for materials and not for coin, and she has decided what she is making for you before you asked.

dialogue.giverOffer: Vesh holds a hand out without looking up. '<Give it here>. It has been through something and I can do more with it now than I could before.'
dialogue.turninReady: She works without hurrying and hands them back. 'Better,' she says. That is the whole of her opinion and it is worth more than it sounds.
dialogue.giverComplete: 'When it has been through something. Not before.'
dialogue.giverInProgress: 'The pair I gave you. I am not making a second set - I am making those again, and better.'

configurations.description: The Reaches as designed in docs/WORLD.md. New characters begin in Gatetown, at the gate that has not opened in living memory.
